title: two_options_max stops counting a free-text C line as an option
description: two_options_max stops counting a line that offers free text (C: tell me a different answer, or Other) as an option, and gains a C-present signal, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 3.

acceptanceCriteria.text: two_options_max no longer counts a line offering free text as a third option
A test fails without the change and passes with it
A genuine third option is still counted and still fails

finalSummary:
two_options_max no longer counts a free-text C line as an option, and reports a cPresent signal. A C or Other line that offers the reader their own answer is excluded from the option count; a C line offering a real third alternative is not free text and is still counted. Detection is a new exported freeTextOption(text) helper and a FREE_TEXT_LINE pattern matching the "C: tell me a different answer" line the styles now write, with or without the word "Option" and with markdown emphasis.

Proved both ways in harness/test/checks.test.mjs: four new tests - a free-text C line scores 1 with cPresent true and no evidence; a real third lettered option still scores below 0.8 with evidence naming the cap; the bare C line and an Other row are both read. Mutated the check (the labelled.delete(c) line disabled) and confirmed exactly the predicted subset went red: one test failed, 248 passed; file restored after.

Gates: npm --prefix harness test 249 pass / 0 fail (was 245); node src/cli.mjs audit exit 0, all 12 checks agree; claude plugin test 21/21; claude plugin validate exit 0. PR opum-ai/plain-english-styles#48 delivered PES-4 and this rides PR 48s successor; see the PR for the merged head.
